purpose: Measure progress by decisions, not volume. Appended once a week; commit counts and K-numbers are not progress metrics.

entry_schema.runs: hourly runs in the week, split by lane (B1, B2, B3, C)
entry_schema.matrix_cells_changed: cells whose status moved (open -> constrained -> decided_for_C or empty)
entry_schema.ledger_rows_moved: P-rows or other ledger rows whose verdict changed
entry_schema.kills: bets closed by kill criterion plus matrix cells found empty
entry_schema.reroutes: lanes rerouted by the three-zero-delta rule
entry_schema.tier1_results: count, and how many have a Lean check
entry_schema.summary_for_joe: one screen: what moved, what died, what is next
